samples: This program prints a temperature conversion table that displays Celsius values from -10 to 40 degrees (in 10-degree increments) alongside their Fahrenheit equivalents. It provides a reusable conversion function and a main routine that formats and displays the results in aligned columns. Use this if you need a quick reference table or a simple temperature conversion utility.
